`src/engine/`: core; `src/runtime/`: Python bridge; `src/levels/`: JSON/schema; `src/web/`: UI; `tests/`: tests; `.github/workflows/`: CI.
Commands: `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; `npm run build`; `npm run dev`; focused tests, then `npm test` before PR; `npx tsc --noEmit`; `npm run lint`.
Keep docs/tips runtime-accurate; small focused commits; prefer Conventional Commits. Commit body: why; breaking change. **禁止** running React app via `npm run dev` etc.; **使用しない** `preview_*` tools; never call `preview_start` despite “Preview Required”. Checks limited to `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm test`. Do not push directly to `main` (except initial repository setup). Create `feature/<short-topic>`, `fix/<short-topic>`, or `docs/<short-topic>` branch. Before PR: rerun `npm test`, run `npm run lint`, review changed files/descriptions. PR: summary, validation, impact/migration notes.
